description: This file defines the SupportsPartitionManagement interface in the Spark SQL connector catalog module, providing APIs for managing table partitions including creation, deletion, purging, renaming, and metadata operations.

classes.name: SupportsPartitionManagement
classes.description: An interface for managing table partitions, including creation, deletion, purging, renaming, and metadata operations, extending the Table interface.

methods.name: partitionSchema
methods.description: Returns the schema of the table's partitions.

methods.name: createPartition
methods.description: Creates a new partition with specified identifier and properties.

methods.name: dropPartition
methods.description: Drops a specified partition from the table.

methods.name: purgePartition
methods.description: Removes a partition and its data, skipping trash, if supported.

methods.name: partitionExists
methods.description: Checks if a partition exists based on its identifier.

methods.name: replacePartitionMetadata
methods.description: Replaces metadata of an existing partition.

methods.name: loadPartitionMetadata
methods.description: Loads metadata of a specified partition.

methods.name: listPartitionIdentifiers
methods.description: Lists identifiers of partitions matching given criteria.

methods.name: truncatePartition
methods.description: Truncates a partition, removing its data.
